id="ic3e222882adf47b7a49a545beeed2f53_3613"></span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">Item 5.02, &#8220;Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers&#8221;</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div style="text-align:justify"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">On October 12, 2026, Jorge Bermudez, who has served as a member of the Board of Directors (the &#8220;Board&#8221;) of Moody&#8217;s Corporation (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) since April 19, 2011, informed the Company of his intention to retire from the Board, effective October 12, 2026. Mr. Bermudez&#8217;s retirement did not result from any disagreement with the Company, its management, or the Board on any matter.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div style="text-align:justify"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">The Company and the Board express their sincere appreciation to Mr. Bermudez for his years of distinguished service and leadership.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div style="text-align:justify"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Following Mr. Bermudez&#8217;s retirement and Mr. Keith Demmings&#8217; election, the size of the Company&#8217;s Board will remain at ten. In addition, in recognition of his service to the Board, the Board approved the removal of the forfeiture requirement otherwise applicable to the restricted stock units previously granted to him in February 2026. Those RSUs will become fully vested.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div style="text-align:justify"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">In light of this retirement, the Board has appointed Ms. Lisa Sawicki as Chairman of the Audit Committee effective immediately. In addition, as previously reported, on August 11, the Board elected Mr. Demmings as a member of the Company&#8217;s Board, effective as of November 1, 2026. The Board has now appointed Mr. Demmings to the Governance &amp; Nominating Committee as well as the Audit Committee. </span></div><div style="text-align:justify"><span><br/></span></div><div style="height:54pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="-sec-extract:summary;text-align:center"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times
